data.one_liner: Customizable animated page indicators with a set of built-in effects for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated page indicators that connect to a PageController or take an active index directly. Supports horizontal and vertical layouts with various built-in styles like Worm, Expanding Dots, Jumping Dot, Slide, Scale, Swap, and Color Transition.
use_when: You need to display a page indicator for a PageView or carousel
You want smooth animations and effects on page transitions
avoid_when: You are not using a multi-page view or carousel
strengths: Wide variety of built-in animated effects
Supports both horizontal and vertical layouts
Allows deep customization through effect properties and CustomizableEffect
weaknesses: Requires managing a PageController or active index manually
Breaking changes in recent major versions regarding default color handling
